candidate_evidence.quote: will study whether music therapy is feasible in newly diagnosed GBM patients undergoing standard care.
Each GBM study participant in Arm A will receive two 30-minute live synchronous virtual music therapy sessions per week for a period of 8 weeks to be curated by a board-certified music therapist.

coder_notes: Phase NA behavioural trial of music therapy; no drug intervention registered. Temozolomide is not a registered intervention but all participants are on standard chemoradiation (exclusion criterion), listed as soc_backbone for transparency.
